origin: KER.PA miss postmortem (chose no action; Gucci crushed earnings under new leadership) generalized. Paired NATURAL EXPERIMENT with IPS.PA (2026-07-31): new-CEO surface pattern, blue ruled paper-only - the discriminants below are what separates them.
mechanism: A new leader with a PROVEN TURNAROUND record and public doubt to disprove, helming a damaged-but-durable franchise, produces returns the market underprices because (a) turnaround skill is rare and partially portable, (b) the doubt at appointment IS the entry discount, (c) the kitchen-sink reset resets the bar mechanically, and (d) sell-side models extrapolate the broken run-rate through the first 2-4 quarters of fix.

discriminants.D1_track_record_specificity: prior DEMONSTRATED turnaround at scale (loss->record, crisis->5x), not competence/incumbency. KER/de Meo: Renault. IPS/Beaver: regional continuity - FAIL.
discriminants.D2_franchise_intactness: brand/franchise equity intact, execution broken - NOT structurally-questioned demand. Gucci: intact. Ipsos: synthetic-panel commoditization - FAIL.
discriminants.D3_mandate_power: full P&L + board backing + freedom to cut; external/clean mandate beats deputy-CEO scaffolding or founder shadow.
discriminants.D4_doubt_discount: market fell/flat on appointment or press doubted = you are PAID for the doubt. If the tape cheered (the Niccol +25% day-one archetype), the great-man premium is pre-paid - screen OUT.
discriminants.D5_entry_window: enter AFTER the kitchen-sink guide-down, before results print: ~2-6 quarters in-seat. Appointment-day entry buys the doubt but eats the reset; late entry pays full price.
discriminants.D6_observable_playbook: the leader's fix has LEADING indicators our machinery can watch (management churn, portfolio pruning, comp inflection, hiring waves) - no fireable tell = dead money per catalyst doctrine.

portability caveat (Groysberg): star performance transfers WITH fit (same function/industry adjacency), decays without - D1 must check adjacency

v2_rules.hard_gates: D1 (demonstrated turnaround at scale, adjacency-checked) AND D2 (franchise damaged-but-durable) - both must pass; either failing = REJECT regardless of price
v2_rules.entry_logic: IF sink pre-dates hire: enter at announcement/first dip. IF sink post-arrival: enter after the first reset (trough 0.5-1.5q). IF arrival was cheered: put on CALENDAR for the 3.5-6q premium-decay trough - these are DEFERRED longs, not rejects
v2_rules.sizing: courts size for a 60-80% conditional hit rate, not certainty; N=5 full-pattern is thin - cohort-tag great_man and let the Brier record grow the confidence
v2_rules.kering_second_lesson: our KER miss was a D5-clock error avant la lettre: the kitchen-sink (3 warnings, De Sarno exit, trough Apr-2025) completed BEFORE de Meo arrived, so announcement day was the entry and 'wait for proof' cost +49.6pp vs LVMH +4.2pp
